body: It can be heard in a court or used to carry briefs?
It can be in a hat, Or out of the bag. If you see it you’ll be smitten, "Cause it’s fluffy like a mitten?
It can be repeated but rarely in the same way. It can't be changed but can be rewritten. It can be passed down but should not be forgotten?
It can be used onstage or to express admiration. What is it?
It can be white or blue or black, Humped or have a horn. And when it talks it sings its menuets, as it’s travelling the depths?
It can cause deflation of tires when dropped from the rear of spy cars?
It can make rain but take away one leg and it'll give you pain?
It can pierce the best armor and make swords crumble with a rub, yet for all its power It can't harm a wooden club?
It can't be seen or felt. It can't be touched or smelt. Behind stars and under hills. All emptiness it fills. What is it?
It cannot be seen, it cannot be felt, Cannot be heard, cannot be smelt, Lies behind stars and under hills and empty holes it fills. Comes first follows after, Ends life kills laughter?
It cannot be seen, it weighs nothing but when put into a barrel, it makes it lighter?
It carries paper of the most important sort but also plastic, I'm glad to report. What is it?
It comes down but never goes up?
It comes from crystal and melts to a treat. Add it to your tea to make it sweet. What is it?
It comes only before, it comes only after. Rises only in darkness but rises only in light. It is always the same but is yet always different?
It could be a tangly game but can also become a destructive weather phenomenon?
It could make arrows fly and kites soar. What is it?
It covers you, you lose it every day and you'd die without it?
It describes an era in history during which lights was hard to come by?
It does hurt when it breaks and if it stops, you are dead?
It doesn't live within a house, nor does it live without. Most will use it when they come in and again when they go out?
It flavors your food and divides the year up. What is it?
It flies when it's on and floats coming off?
It flies without wings?
It floats over the land, It cuts the tallest mountain, Its voice is like a fountain, Its body like a snake, Will flow into a lake?
It flows out of the soil, It burns you if it boils and holds us in its coils, More valuable than gold, As black as it is old?
It gets passed among men and builds without growing. It serves to injure from a source unknowing. What is it?
It gives everything and then takes it away, It governs destinies and fates, It changes and it never waits, It rules the cards and dice each day, Is part of any game we play?
It goes around the world but stays in a corner?
It goes into the water black and comes out red?
It goes up but at the same time goes down Up toward the sky and down to the ground. It's present tense and past tense too, Come for a ride, just me and you?
It goes up but never comes down?
It goes up the hill and down the hill and yet stands still?
It happens when a professor's brain goes missing?
It happens when something has been cut with H2O?
It has 4 lucky leaves. What is it?
It has 88 keys but none of these will open a door?
It has a face and two hands but no arms or legs?
It has a face and two hands but no arms or legs. What is this?
It has a neck but no head and wears a cap? What is it?
It has no legs to dance, it has no lungs to breathe, it has no life to live or die and yet it does all three?
It has no top or bottom but it can hold flesh, bones and blood all at the same time?
It has plenty of backbone But doesn't have a let. It peels like an orange But it comes from an egg?
It has roots that nobody sees. It is taller than trees. Up, u pit goes. Yet it never grows. What is it?
It has two bands but no money?
It hisses but it’s not a snake. It holds water but it’s not a lake. When it’s done you hear it scream. Pour from it and add some cream?
It holds most knowledge that has ever been said. But is not the brain, is not the head. To feathers and their masters, it's both bane and boonOne empty and one full?
It holds no blessings in disguise. Its rhymes are aimed at your demise, it’s cast only to ruin, Whatever you are doin’?
It increases and decreases Yet no one see it. It is not a fire And yet it can be quenched?
It is a big and bulky mammal and has a trunk just like a tree. Will store water in its nose, Which is long and like a hose?
